gear_thanks: Thank you, Pioneer DJ / AlphaTheta. Your gear is overpriced as fuck — if I have to refinance my house to afford a DJ setup, the fucking nightclub had better be included. But the moments I’ve had behind those decks? Priceless.
code_thanks: Pioneer took my money. ChatGPT & Codex came back for whatever was left. But one gave me unforgettable nights behind the decks, and the others saved me countless nights fighting with code for this project. Fuck the prices. Love what you helped me do.
